instruct: An elderly man in his seventies, his low-pitch voice features a dry, reedier rasp and a subtle, rhythmic tremor; he speaks at a measured, deliberate pace with a steady, grounded resonance for expressive character dialogue.
refText: Zwölf Boxkämpfer jagen Viktor quer über den großen Sylter Deich, und sie fragte sich, was der morgige Tag bringen würde.
